question: How does the same will-power become the letters ra and la?
premises: The same power becomes tinged by the stain of the knowable.
This occurs more quickly as it turns toward what is different.
Through that turning it becomes ra and la.
inference: Accelerated orientation toward otherness transforms the same power into the states of ra and la.
plain_english: That very same power, more quickly tinged by the stain of the knowable, and turned toward what is different, goes to the state of ra and to the state of la.
